frame.converter: Each sky position onto the midplane of the inclined disc the image layers are baked on (recipe.json), through the image-layer bake's own intersection.

discThickness.basis: The stellar disc's exponential scale height as its scale length over 7.3, the mean flattening Kregel et al. (2002) measured for edge-on discs, with S4G's exponential disc scale length, 127.3″ (Salo et al. 2015): 568 pc. The same thickness as the image layers' slabs; for young objects it is an upper value. Each row's own height is drawn, not measured.

meaning: Candidate globular clusters of M101 from Simanton et al. (2015), in ten Hubble fields over the inner disc: one dot per cluster at its catalogue position. The bright ones belong to the halo; here every cluster is placed on the disc.

appearance.note: Presentation only: the Milky Way globular clusters' warm orange. Each dot takes its tone and half its colour from the photograph under it (packages/bake/cli/prepare-catalogue-points.mts).
